title: fix(a11y): correct the report button label spelling
body:
## Summary

The report button has an arrow for sighted users and an explicit accessible name. Fix its misspelled “Downlaod report” label to “Download report”; update the DOM test that currently enshrines the typo.

The transposed letters are pronounced poorly by speech output. This is a label correction: click behavior, tab order, and focus styles are unchanged.

Validation plan: run the report-button DOM test and inspect the accessibility tree for the exact name “Download report”. A screen-reader spot check should confirm that the existing button still exposes the same action.
